moves.name: Melee attacks, hits 1-2
moves.desc: First two weapon-bash hits of the 3-hit melee (10, 10): spawned from two places in the bow code, same record both times; the melee has no guide label, Heaven/Storm/Extreme replace it with the Shoryuken (MV 10)
moves.input: Melee button, up to 3 presses (Earth style)

moves.name: Melee attacks, hit 3
moves.desc: Third (last) weapon-bash hit (18) spawned from its own place in the bow code; the calculator also has a Wide Pellet Arc of 18 (Extreme) but that is an arrow, not a k0 hit (MV 18)
moves.input: Melee button, 3rd press (Earth style)

moves.name: Rapid arrow 1
moves.desc: Rapid shot arrow number 1 of the charged rapid volley (LV1 fires 1 arrow, LV4 fires 4: 14, 6, 5, 3); the shot hits this record when it is the 1th arrow (MV 14)
moves.input: Release at charge Lv1-Lv4 with the Rapid arrow type

moves.name: Rapid arrow 2
moves.desc: Rapid shot arrow number 2 of the charged rapid volley (LV1 fires 1 arrow, LV4 fires 4: 14, 6, 5, 3); the shot hits this record when it is the 2th arrow (MV 6)
moves.input: Release at charge Lv1-Lv4 with the Rapid arrow type

moves.name: Rapid arrow 3
moves.desc: Rapid shot arrow number 3 of the charged rapid volley (LV1 fires 1 arrow, LV4 fires 4: 14, 6, 5, 3); the shot hits this record when it is the 3th arrow (MV 5)
moves.input: Release at charge Lv1-Lv4 with the Rapid arrow type

moves.name: Rapid arrow 4
moves.desc: Rapid shot arrow number 4 of the charged rapid volley (LV1 fires 1 arrow, LV4 fires 4: 14, 6, 5, 3); the shot hits this record when it is the 4th arrow (MV 3)
moves.input: Release at charge Lv1-Lv4 with the Rapid arrow type

moves.name: Scatter arrow, outer
moves.desc: Outer arrow of the scatter (spread) shot (4,6,4 / 4,6,6,6,4 / 4,6,7,6,4 patterns); this record has a different hidden field (13) than the other arrows (10), so it may also be the Extreme horizontal rising shot (MV 4)
moves.input: Release at charge with the Spread arrow type

moves.name: Scatter arrow, middle
moves.desc: Middle arrow of the scatter shot (6): LV1 4-6-4 uses it once, LV2 6-7-6 twice (MV 6)
moves.input: Release at charge with the Spread arrow type

moves.name: Scatter arrow, centre
moves.desc: Centre arrow of the strongest scatter patterns (7, as in 6-7-6 and 4-6-7-6-4); the same MV 7 as the pierce arrows (8-13), told apart by the record order (4,6,7, then 7 x6) (MV 7)
moves.input: Release at charge Lv2/Lv4 with the Spread arrow type

moves.name: Pierce arrow, hit 1
moves.desc: Pierce (penetrating) arrow: the same value for each body it passes, six records for up to 6 hits (LV4 pierce is 7x6); records 8-13 are identical, the number is the guess of the order (MV 7)
moves.input: Release at charge with the Pierce arrow type

moves.desc: Pierce (penetrating) arrow: the same value for each body it passes, six records for up to 6 hits (LV4 pierce is 7x6); records 8-13 are identical, the number is the guess of the order (MV 7)

moves.name: Sniper / Arrow Rain arrow (12)
moves.desc: Arrow of the crouch Sniper Shot (12x5, Lv4/5, Storm and Extreme) or the Extreme Arrow Rain arc (12x7): same MV 12; which one cannot be told from the record alone (MV 12)
moves.input: Crouch aimed shot (しゃがみ照準撃ち k355) at charge Lv4-5, or an arc shot

moves.name: Piercing Sniper arrow (first value 10)
moves.desc: First value 10 of the Piercing Sniper Shot (10x5, 25, 10, 5, 4, 2; Lv4/5, Storm and Extreme); also close to the Melee 10, but this is an arrow-type record (MV 10)
moves.input: Crouch aimed shot with the Pierce arrow type at charge Lv4-5

moves.name: Horizontal Rising Shot arrow
moves.desc: Arrow of the Extreme Horizontal Rising Shot (4; charged 1.0x raw 1.5x element); the calculator's Vertical Rising Shot (40) has no record in this list; the same MV 4 as the scatter outer arrow (MV 4)
moves.input: Rising shot (昇天煌弓 k377), Extreme

moves.name: Bow effect object 1 (MV 0)
moves.desc: MV-0 object with a 60-frame window, spawned from the bow code (two functions, 0x10307150 and 0x10307300, ids 12-15 each); probably tied to the four charge levels (Lv1-4) as a visual or effect marker, not seen as damage (MV 0)
moves.input: Charging the bow
